observations.title: Weak trend structure (4/7 trend-template checks)
observations.detail: Missing: 150-day above 200-day; 200-day average rising vs a month ago; price within 25% of the 52-week high. Leaders in a Stage 2 uptrend typically meet all seven; stocks failing several are rarely where the strongest moves start.

observations.title: Extended: 22% above the 50-day average
observations.detail: Stocks stretched this far above their average often pull back or consolidate; buying here means a wider gap to the nearest support.

observations.title: Golden cross: 50-day moved above the 200-day (last 10 sessions)
observations.detail: A slow, lagging signal: it confirms a trend change that has already started.

observations.title: 53% below the 52-week high
observations.detail: A long way from the highs: overhead supply from holders who bought higher can cap rallies.

observations.title: RSI 72: overbought zone
observations.detail: In strong uptrends RSI can stay above 70 for weeks, so it is not a sell signal by itself; it does mean new buys are chasing strength.
